nodes.description: Modifier that performs a low-level external call to the stopTheBots protection contract before executing the modified function body.
Address of the Ferrum bot-protection contract invoked via low-level call inside checkBots and list.
Internal owner address of the protection base contract; used as privileged account holding delegate/listing rights.
Public Uniswap pair address, computed in the constructor and forwarded to the bot-protection call.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance spender checks, minting/transfer origin and owner authorization.
Origin of the transaction; used as owner and as the allowance/beneficiary account in the constructor.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to build the Uniswap liquidity deadline.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an owner-supplied address and calldata, executing foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Low-level external call to stopTheBots using raw selector 0x15274141, executed before any balance state change.
Unchecked Solidity 0.7 arithmetic on allowance and balanceOf (subtraction and addition) with no SafeMath.
Low-level external call to stopTheBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 and the caller-supplied recipient array.
External call to the Uniswap V2 router addLiquidityETH with msg.value and a timestamp-based deadline.
Constructor that sets owner from tx.origin, derives the Uniswap pair and grants unlimited allowances.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transfer with the checkBots modifier; performs balance and allowance updates before returning.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without restrictions.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall with caller-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only listing function that rewrites balances, adds Uniswap liquidity and mass-distributes tokens from a supplied array.
Internal pure helper computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address from two tokens.
Public nested allowance mapping mutated by approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Public balance mapping mutated by transferFrom and list using unchecked arithmetic.
Fixed token supply (96,000,000e18) used to compute the owner allocation in list.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for addLiquidityETH and pre-approved with unlimited allowance.
Wrapped BNB address used together with the token to derive the Uniswap pair.
Source account of the transfer, forwarded to the bot-protection modifier.
Destination account of the transfer, forwarded to the bot-protection modifier.
Amount transferred, forwarded to the bot-protection modifier and used in unchecked arithmetic.
Recipient passed straight through to transferFrom.
Amount passed straight through to transferFrom.
Address granted the allowance by approve.
Allowance amount written into the allowance mapping.
Arbitrary target address supplied to the delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata supplied to the delegatecall.
Amount used as the contract's balance and as the token amount for liquidity provisioning.
Array of recipients written into balanceOf and passed to the protection contract.
Array of amounts assigned to each recipient balance.
First token used to order and hash the pair address.
Second token used to order and hash the pair address.
Lexicographically smaller token of the pair.
Lexicographically larger token of the pair.
Computed Uniswap pair address returned to the constructor.
Boolean result of the protection call that gates the modifier.
Success flag returned by the raw delegatecall.
Loop index used for the mass balance distribution.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the delegated transfer call.
msg.sender is the spender checked against allowance[_from][msg.sender], gating third-party transfers.
msg.sender is the allowance owner whose spender map entry is written.
msg.sender must equal owner, otherwise the delegatecall is reverted.
msg.sender must equal owner to list tokens and rewrite balances.
owner is set to tx.origin inside the constructor, making authorization origin-based.
block.timestamp + 600 forms the liquidity deadline inside list, a miner-influenced value.
The deadline argument of addLiquidityETH derives from block.timestamp.
transferFrom applies the checkBots modifier, executing an external call before balances are updated.
The modifier body performs the low-level stopTheBots.call before delegating to the function body.
stopTheBots is the callee address used by the modifier's low-level call.
uniPair is encoded into the calldata of the bot-protection call.
The untrusted external call can re-enter transferFrom before allowance and balances are decremented.
transferFrom performs allowance -= _value and balance additions/subtractions without overflow checks.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is unchecked arithmetic in Solidity 0.7.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked arithmetic.
delegate executes the raw delegatecall instruction.
Parameter a is the target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the raw calldata executed by the delegatecall.
Arbitrary delegatecall code runs in this contract's storage context and may re-enter delegate.
list performs a low-level call to stopTheBots after provisioning liquidity.
The untrusted stopTheBots call occurs before the balance distribution loop, allowing reentrancy.
list invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
The external router call happens after balanceOf mutations but before the distribution loop.
uniRouter is the contract on which addLiquidityETH is invoked.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 computes the owner allocation inside list.
wBNB is passed as one token to pairForUniswap.
The constructor calls pairForUniswap to derive uniPair.
The constructor writes the computed pair into the uniPair state variable.
The constructor writes unlimited allowances into the allowance mapping.
The constructor grants allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] = uint(-1), tying approval to the transaction origin.
Parameter _from flows into the balance and allowance updates of transferFrom.
Parameter _to receives the credited balance inside transferFrom.
Parameter _value drives the unchecked subtraction and addition on balances and allowance.
_from is forwarded into the bot-protection call inside the checkBots modifier.
_to is forwarded into the bot-protection call inside the checkBots modifier.
_value is forwarded into the bot-protection call inside the checkBots modifier.
balanceOf entries of sender and recipient are read and written with unchecked arithmetic.
allowance entry is read, validated and decremented without SafeMath.
_to is forwarded from transfer to transferFrom.
_value is forwarded from transfer to transferFrom.
_spender is the key written in the allowance mapping by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
approve mutates the allowance state variable for msg.sender and _spender.
_numList sets balanceOf[address(this)] and the liquidity token amount.
_tos is iterated to assign balances and emit Transfer events.
_amounts provides the credited values for each recipient in the distribution loop.
tokenA is compared and hashed when ordering the pair tokens.
tokenB is compared and hashed when ordering the pair tokens.
list writes arbitrary balances (including totalSupply * 6 / 100) into balanceOf without SafeMath.
The constructor pre-approves uniRouter in the allowance mapping, enabling router pulls.
The constructor uses wBNB together with the token address to derive the pair.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only used inside transferFrom to index balances and allowance and to feed the checkBots modifier.
_to is only used inside transferFrom as the credited balance key.
_value is the operand of the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_to is a pass-through argument of transfer immediately forwarded to transferFrom.
_value is a pass-through argument of transfer immediately forwarded to transferFrom.
_spender is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
_value is only used as the stored allowance amount inside approve.
Parameter a is the raw delegatecall target address and has no other use.
Parameter b is the raw calldata executed by the delegatecall.
_numList is only consumed inside list as the contract balance and liquidity amount.
_tos is only iterated inside list for balance assignment and event emission.
_amounts is only indexed inside list for balance assignment.
tokenA is only used to order and hash the pair inside pairForUniswap.
tokenB is only used to order and hash the pair inside pairForUniswap.
token0 is a temporary ordering variable local to pairForUniswap.
token1 is a temporary ordering variable local to pairForUniswap.
pair is the return value computed and returned by pairForUniswap.
notABot is the boolean result of the protection call that gates the checkBots modifier.
success is the raw return flag of the delegatecall performed in delegate.
i is the loop counter of the distribution loop inside list.
